name: 直式大圖＋右上小圖＋下沉文字欄
desc: 左側一張直式大圖撐起整個區塊高度，右欄上方靠右放一張小橫式圖，文字集中在右欄下半部，和大圖下緣對齊。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。左右兩欄，內容對齊頁面內容寬度：左側放一張直式大圖，約佔內容寬度的四成，撐起整個區塊的高度；右欄從畫面中線附近開始，上方靠右放一張小的橫式圖片，約佔內容寬度的兩成，上緣和左側大圖的上緣對齊。右欄下半部放一段靠左對齊的文字，約佔內容寬度的三分之一：標題（可多行），下方是說明文字段落，最下方可放一個帶箭頭的文字連結，沒有時省略。小圖和文字之間留大片空白，文字集中在右欄下半部，最下緣和左側大圖的下緣對齊；區塊下方不留白，大圖與文字的下緣都貼齊區塊的下緣。
mobile: 改為直向堆疊：直式大圖在最上方，靠左，約佔畫面寬的八成多、右側留白多於左側；下方依序是標題、說明文字段落與文字連結，都靠左對齊。右欄上方的小橫式圖片隱藏。區塊上方不留白，大圖貼齊區塊的上緣；區塊下方仍不留白，文字的最下緣貼齊區塊的下緣。

en.name: Portrait image + small top-right image + low-set text column
en.desc: A tall portrait image on the left spans the section height, a small landscape image sits top-right, and the text sits in the lower half of the right column, aligned with the bottom of the large image.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. Use two columns aligned to the page content width: on the left, place a large portrait image about four tenths of the content width that spans the full height of the section; the right column starts near the horizontal center of the viewport, with a small landscape image at its top, aligned right, about two tenths of the content width, its top edge aligned with the top edge of the large image. In the lower half of the right column, place a left-aligned block of text about one third of the content width: a title (may wrap to multiple lines), a description paragraph below it, and optionally a text link with an arrow at the bottom; omit it when there is no content. Leave a large empty space between the small image and the text, keeping the text in the lower half of the right column with its bottom edge aligned with the bottom edge of the large image; the section has no spacing at the bottom, with the large image and the text both flush with the bottom edge of the section.
en.mobile: Stack vertically: the large portrait image comes first, aligned left at a little over eight tenths of the viewport width, with more empty space on its right than on its left; below it follow the title, the description paragraph and the text link, all aligned left. The small landscape image from the top of the right column is hidden. The section has no spacing at the top, with the large image flush with the top edge of the section; it still has no spacing at the bottom, with the bottom of the text flush with the bottom edge of the section.
